title.en: Markdown and the boundary of reading tools

text.zh: 文档同时服务人类阅读和 Agent 检索。项目结构、档案及稳定记录由文件与项目契约维护，阅读工具只作为前端。核心结构和导航不依赖某个阅读器或社区插件；确有展示需要时可使用插件辅助，但正常使用不得依赖它。
text.en: Documents serve both human reading and agent retrieval. Project structure, archives and stable records are maintained by files and the project contract; reading tools are only a front end. The core structure and navigation must not depend on one reader or community plugin; a plugin may assist where display genuinely needs it, but normal use must not depend on it.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 设计或维护项目文档、档案及导航结构时
trigger.en: When designing or maintaining project documents, archives and navigation

purpose.zh: 让文档同时服务人类阅读与 Agent 检索，不绑定某个阅读器
purpose.en: Let documents serve both human reading and agent retrieval without binding to one reader

exclude.zh: 确有展示需要时才辅助使用的阅读器或插件功能（正常使用不得依赖）
exclude.en: Reader or plugin features used only where display genuinely needs them (normal use must not depend on them)
